theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (p : (Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P)) (g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (δ : ℝ), StrictMono p.2 → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → 0 < δ → ∃ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m), ∃ y ∈ tsupport g, dist x (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)) ≤ δ) ∧ ∀ y : Euclid (m + 1), exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 k) (1 : ℝ)) = LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g y)
